Subject: HaloHealth MSA & Order Form — intake, initial asks and evidence list

Hi Andrew —

Great to meet you on the call earlier. I’m attaching a first-pass MSA and Order Form for HaloHealth to review. To help our contracting and legal teams triage the intake quickly, can you confirm the items below? A short reply with the bullets is perfect.

Quick asks:
- Legal entity to sign (exact legal name):
- Billing entity (if different):
- Primary contract owner / signer (name, title, email):
- Procurement contact (name, email, preferred PO process):
- Any specific security evidence required beyond SOC 2 (e.g., FedRAMP, HIPAA BAAs):

Attachments: HaloHealth_MSA_Draft_v1.docx (MS Word), OrderForm_HaloHealth_v1.xlsx (Excel), redline_instructions.pdf (PDF)

If it helps, our legal lead Kimberly (cc’d) will do a first-pass redline and circulate an annotated version. Target timeline from our side: initial redline sent within 2 business days after we receive the signing entity.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Jonas —

Thanks for sending this over. Answers below:
- Legal entity: Halo Health, Inc. (exact as on W-9)
- Billing entity: Halo Health, Inc.
- Primary contract owner / signer: Andrew Li, VP of Ops, andrew.li@halohealth.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Andrew Li <andrew.li@halohealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-16T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HaloHealth MSA & Order Form — intake, initial asks and evidence list

Andrew / Jonas —

Thanks for the details, Andrew. I reviewed the draft MSA and Order Form quickly and will produce a tracked-redline with commentary. A few items I’ll flag proactively so you’re not surprised:

1) Data residency & processing: We have a standard clause that defaults to Redwood-hosted deployments. If you require specific EU/region residency or dedicated instance language, flag that now.
2) Liability cap & indemnities: We will propose Redwood’s standard commercial cap (1x annual fees) and carve-outs for IP claims; if HaloHealth has counterproposal language, please share.
3) Security attachment: I’ll attach a short evidence package (SOC 2 summary + control narrative) and link to our security portal; if your team needs an encrypted artifact or signed letter, let me know.
4) Order Form pricing cadence: We can add a quarterly review clause for price adjustment notifications and notice periods.

I’ll circulate an internal redline by EOD today and send a client-facing version after Marissa has sanity-checked billing/contact fields.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: redline_instructions.pdf (internal guidance)

Kimberly / Jonas —

We received the MSA and the Order Form. A couple of process items from our side:
- We require the final MSA to include the full legal name and EIN on the signature page; please leave space in the template for the EIN.
- Our standard PO flow is via Coupa; to issue a PO we need the invoice remittance address and Redwood’s vendor ID (if available).
- On Exhibit B (Data Processing), can you confirm whether Redwood will sign our standard DPA or prefer to incorporate data-processing terms into the MSA?

Nicole Ramos

Halo Health

Nicole —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Responses and next steps below:

- Signature/EIN: We will leave an EIN field on the signature page. Please send the exact EIN string you want populated at signing.
- Invoice remittance & vendor ID: Marissa, can you drop our vendor remittance and Redwood vendor ID for HaloHealth? (Marissa: marissa_cole@redwood.ai)
- DPA vs Exhibit B: Kimberly suggests we incorporate the essential data processing duties into Exhibit B of the MSA for speed, and provide our standard DPA as an appendix if you prefer. Kimberly — can you draft Exhibit B language consistent with our DPA and mark where a standalone DPA would slot?
- Timeline / MAP: Proposed mutual action plan: 1) Redwood issues client-facing redline w/ comments (Kimberly) — by 8/19; 2) HaloHealth legal review — by 8/24; 3) Procurement final PO and signer confirmation — by 8/27; 4) Target signature via DocuSign by 8/31. Does that timeline work for your teams?

Links: client-facing redline will be uploaded to this Drive folder for visibility: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDEF-ExampleLink
